allowed_roots.ci: compatibility fixtures, host validation and evidence
allowed_roots.cli: Artist CLI source and host tests
allowed_roots.docs: human architecture, references and migration history
allowed_roots.tests: integration contracts and frozen Legacy provenance
allowed_roots..devcontainer: optional future developer container; directory need not exist

intentional_exceptions..devcontainer: Future development container root is allowed without creating an empty directory.
intentional_exceptions.generated_ignored_files: Git-ignored Unity/.NET/build outputs are not authored root ownership; forbidden directory names are still checked outside generated caches.
intentional_exceptions.historical_references: p0-inventory, p4-path-map, immutable legacy fixture and historical evidence preserve original source paths; these do not designate current runtime authority.
intentional_exceptions.Agent importer compatibility: CI temporarily supports exactly one known old/new Agent importer; unknown or ambiguous layouts fail closed. Remove old variant only after all retained supported sources no longer need it.
